description: This Java source file defines the class MonkeyPermissionEvent, which is a subclass of MonkeyEvent. It is responsible for injecting permission grant or revoke events for a specified package and permission within the Android Monkey testing framework. The class contains methods to determine whether to grant or revoke permissions and performs the corresponding actions via Android system services.

classes.name: MonkeyPermissionEvent
classes.description: Represents an event to grant or revoke a runtime permission for a specific package in the Android Monkey testing framework.

methods.name: MonkeyPermissionEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a package name and permission info.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Performs the injection of the permission grant or revoke, interacting with system services.
